title: I’ve Covered Cycling Since Payphones. Pogačar’s Vuelta Crash Showed How Much Has Changed.
content:
From print deadlines to Instagram Reels, one dramatic afternoon at the Vuelta a España revealed how the age of instant news is changing the way we cover the peloton.

Read the full article at I’ve Covered Cycling Since Payphones. Pogačar’s Vuelta Crash Showed How Much Has Changed. on Velo.
author: Josh Ross
